CORAM : ADVAIT M. SETHNA, J.
 DATE : 29 JULY 2025 P. C. :
1. Heard the learned Advocates for the parties.
2. The application is listed for the first time today.
3. Issue Notice to the Respondent, returnable on 04 August 2025.
Learned APP Mr Narwade waives service of notice on behalf of Respondent/State.
4. The Application is filed under Section 482 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023, as the Applicant apprehends arrest.
The proceedings relate to Crime No.0420/2025.
The FIR is dated 08 July 2025 at 21:42 hours registered by the Pathari Police Station, District Parbhani.

The offences alleged are under  1295.25aba  (2)
Sections 59(i) 59(ii) of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 and Rajesh Omprakash Rathi vs The State Of Maharashtra on 29 July, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/149768005/
1 under Sections 123, 223, 274, 275 and 3(5) of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023.

sentences.text: The occurrence of the alleged offence is shown on 08 July 2025.
The informant is one Santosh Uttamrao Maral, aged 36 years who is P.S.I. of the Pathari Police Station.
5. According to the learned Advocate for the Applicant the name of the present Applicant has surfaced for the first time on the statement of the co-accused during the investigation.
The learned APP Mr Narwade would state that the Applicant is the supplier of the said unauthorized product.
6. At the outset, it is pointed out that the product involved here is scented Jarda (scented Gutkha).
The parties would agree that this product involves the issue covered by the orders passed in Anticipatory Bail Application No.857/2025 and other companion Anticipatory Bail Applications.
The Applicants in those Applications have been protected by the interim orders.
Those matters are listed for further consideration/hearing on coming Monday i.e. on 04 August 2025.
It would be just and proper to place this Application along with those Applications.

Considering that similar issues are involved and those Applicants have been protected by the orders of this Court as noted above, this Applicant deserves protection at this stage by passing following orders :-

sentences.text:
(i) Until adjourned date of hearing, in the event of arrest of the Applicant Rajesh Omprakash Rathi in connection with C.R. No.0420/2025, registered with Pathari Police Station, District Parbhani, for the offences punishable under under Sections 59(i) 59(ii) of the Food Safety and Standards Act,
2006 and under Sections 123, 223, 274, 275 and 3(5) of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023, he is directed to be released on bail on his furnishing PR bond in the sum of Rs. 20,000/- (Rupees Twenty Thousand Only) with one or more sureties in the like amount.
(ii) The applicant shall attend the concerned Police Station on every Friday at 11.30 am, until the further orders and shall cooperate with the investigation.
(iii) The Applicant shall furnish details of residential address and other contact details such as the mobile number etc. to the concerned police station.
If there is any change in the contact details, the same shall be immediately informed to the concerned police station.

(iv) The applicant shall not leave the jurisdiction of the competent Court without prior permission,
until further orders.
(v) He shall not contact and/or influence the witness/es and/or tamper with the evidence in any manner whatsoever.
List the Application for further consideration/hearing on 04 August 2025.
9. The protection granted today in favour of the Applicant shall continue until the adjourned date of hearing.
